question: CBE – Projetos e Engenharia em Telecomunicações, S.A., is a company with a registered office in Vila Franca de Xira and a share capital of EUR 200 000. Its core business is telecommunications engineering and related technical activities. The employees of this company in Vialonga, Portugal, were surprised by the company’s insolvency – although wages were overdue, the company still had orders and customers.

The workers complain that the company has breached its contractual obligations at a time when its earning statement has shown significant profits, with the company even renewing its car fleet at the end of last year. In view of the above: 1.
Does the Commission have information on whether CBE has benefitted from any European funds? If so, which?
Is it aware of the above matter?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (5.4.2024) According to the list of approved operations communicated by the Portuguese authorities, CBE – Projetos e Engenharia em Telecomunicações, S.A.

benefitted from a total of EUR 237 791 from the European Regional Development Fund and the European Social Fund throughout the 2007-2013 programming period, to support projects of Qualification and Internationalisation and Training for Innovation and Management. No financial support has been granted to this beneficiary during the 2014-2020 and 2021-2027 programming periods.
The Commission was not aware of the above matter mentioned by the Honourable Member.
